traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Choose the kind of dragon from the Draconic Ancestors table (Black/Acid, Blue/Lightning, Brass/Fire, Bronze/Lightning, Copper/Acid, Gold/Fire, Green/Poison, Red/Fire, Silver/Cold, White/Cold). Your choice affects your Breath Weapon, Damage Resistance, and appearance.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 1d10 damage of the type determined by your Draconic Ancestry. This damage increases by 1d10 at character levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10). You can use this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses on a Long Rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.description: When you reach character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight. As a Bonus Action, you sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract them or have the Incapacitated condition. During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching a stone surface to use this Tremorsense. You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet (120 feet if you choose the Drow lineage).

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage: Drow (Darkvision 120 ft., Dancing Lights cantrip; level 3: Faerie Fire; level 5: Darkness), High Elf (Prestidigitation cantrip, swappable on Long Rest; level 3: Detect Magic; level 5: Misty Step), or Wood Elf (Speed 35 ft., Druidcraft cantrip; level 3: Longstrider; level 5: Pass without Trace). Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill (your choice).

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.description: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.description: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose one: Forest Gnome (know Minor Illusion cantrip; always have Speak with Animals prepared, can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses on a Long Rest) or Rock Gnome (know Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips; can spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device). Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.description: You are descended from Giants. Choose one supernatural boon from your ancestry (usable a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses on a Long Rest): Cloud's Jaunt (teleport 30 ft. as Bonus Action), Fire's Burn (deal 1d10 extra Fire damage on a hit), Frost's Chill (deal 1d6 extra Cold damage and reduce Speed by 10 ft. on a hit), Hill's Tumble (give Prone condition to Large or smaller creature on a hit), Stone's Endurance (Reaction: roll 1d12 + CON modifier to reduce damage taken), or Storm's Thunder (Reaction: deal 1d8 Thunder damage to a creature within 60 ft. that damaged you).

traits.name: Large Form
traits.description: Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you're in a big enough space. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it. For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can't stop in the same space.

traits.name: Luck
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

name: Human

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: You gain an Origin feat of your choice (see Feats). Skilled is recommended.

language_desc: Humans speak Common and one additional language of their choice.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.description: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.description: You are the recipient of a legacy that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a legacy: Abyssal (Resistance to Poison damage, Poison Spray cantrip; level 3: Ray of Sickness; level 5: Hold Person), Chthonic (Resistance to Necrotic damage, Chill Touch cantrip; level 3: False Life; level 5: Ray of Enfeeblement), or Infernal (Resistance to Fire damage, Fire Bolt cantrip; level 3: Hellish Rebuke; level 5: Darkness). Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. When you cast it with this trait, the spell uses the same spellcasting ability you use for your Fiendish Legacy trait.
